title: Random-subspace tests and trace smoothing for coordinate sweeps

abstractEnglish: We prove that an absolute number of coordinate sweeps of the Thorp shuffle on $`n=2^d`$ positions brings the full permutation to total-variation distance at most $`\frac12n^{-5}`$ from uniform, uniformly over the initial deck. Thus $`O(d)`$ physical shuffles suffice, which is optimal in order.
